title: Just Simplified
description: Just optimizes your game! Good for Low-End PCs.
body:
Just Simplified: A Modpack for Smooth Performance

Are you tired of laggy gameplay? Want a smoother Minecraft experience without sacrificing aesthetics? This modpack is designed with low-end PCs in mind, combining performance optimization with beautiful shaders to enhance your visuals without tanking your frame rate.

Key Features:

- Performance Boost: Optimized configurations and mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Entity Culling to ensure better FPS and reduced lag.
- Shader Compatibility: Lightweight shader options that bring vibrant lighting and shadows while maintaining a stable performance.
- Minimalist Design: Only the essentials—no unnecessary content, ensuring your game runs smoothly.
- Simple Voice Chat: Talk to players nearby or in groups with clear, in-game voice communication.

Whether you're exploring vast landscapes, building intricate structures, or just enjoying the game with friends, this modpack will make your Minecraft journey smoother and more visually stunning. Perfect for players who want the best of both worlds—optimized performance and enhanced graphics!
